Maya: FYI — VanguardAI QBR next Mon 9am PT. Need a 1-page token econ, a 60/90 day spend forecast, and a short enablement checklist. Who owns numbers?
Ibrahim: I can assemble forecast if Kelsey exports per-endpoint usage (last 120d).
Kelsey: Exporting now. Will include embed vs gen split and top 10 routes.
cost-bot: Alert: VanguardAI hit 3x their baseline daily spend yesterday. Admin notified.
Maya: Call out renewal window (in 38 days) and mark as elevated risk if forecast shows >30% month-over-month growth.
Ibrahim: Quick snapshot from my query: total_tokens_120d=52,000,000; generation=34,000,000; embeddings=18,000,000; model_mix=rwd-4b (48%), open-13b (28%), embed-lite (24%); avg_monthly_spend=$20,400; 30d_change=+47%.
Kelsey: Uploaded CSV -> https://drive.redwood.internal/vanguard/qbr_export_120.csv
Maya: Ops recs: 1) move high-volume embeds to async batch jobs, 2) enable prefix caching for top prompts, 3) trial int8 on non-critical open-13b endpoints.
Ibrahim: Scenario table idea: baseline, +30% growth, int8-on-open13b, batch-embeds-60pct. Early math: int8 on open-13b ~35% saving on that model -> ~10% total spend drop; batching 60% embeds -> additional ~8% drop.
Kelsey: Their traffic concentrates 8am-1pm PT. Suggest model-pinning to smaller variant off-peak.
cost-bot: Reminder: next invoice in 10 days. Consider short commit offer in the QBR options slide.
Maya: Owners: Ibrahim = forecast & scenarios, Kelsey = data + charts, Maya = renewal outreach + deck. Drafts by Fri EOD please.
Kelsey: Will paste a 3-line embed-cache snippet from /templates/embed_tips.md into the deck.
Ibrahim: I'll add a tiny sensitivity chart and a one-row ROI estimate for the int8 trial.
Maya: Great. Sync Thu 11am to review deck.
Kelsey: ack.
Ibrahim: ack.
cost-bot: Flag set: renewal-risk = moderate.
Maya: Thanks team — aiming for a crisp 6-slide QBR and a 1-page enablement checklist.
